s01041.summary: Four fishers and sleeping Ansel settle in the glowing shanty, trading small talk.
Teddy hooks a fish, struggles, and loses it, laughing while the adults cheer.
Quiet settles; Brigid asks whether the lake talks, and the ice groans.
Teddy hears humming; Hollis and Margot dismiss it in unison, neither smiling.
Ansel warns them off the hole as a pale hand rises and grips Teddy's mitten.

s01107.summary: Milo climbs up to Sadie's ledge; she silently makes room and they sit.
Milo offers a cracker; they share it in the dark.
Playful shoving nearly sends Sadie off the ledge; Milo catches her sleeve.
Sadie offers her hand and they climb down together.

s01035.summary: Renata, Miles and Adebayo wait in the dark gift shop; the captain orders them to stay.
Adebayo and Miles joke about snow globes and a cure.
Adebayo coughs; Miles presses him and learns the cough dates from Tuesday.
Renata reaches for the radio and accuses Miles of lying about symptoms.
Searchlights from an unknown hull sweep the promenade; the captain warns them to stay hidden.

s01102.summary: In the soaked tent, Marisol on a chair tries to rally guests nobody hears.
The canopy leaks; three dive for the cake and slide into the mud.
Marisol laughs, toasts the wettest wedding, and leaps into Adebayo's arms.

s01043.summary: Cornelia strides into Thaddeus's assay office and drops a pouch of gold dust.
Thaddeus tests the dust with acid while she dryly answers his questions.
They haggle to seventeen dollars an ounce; he pays and she leaves uncounted.
Thaddeus fishes about her being alone; she reveals a claim and a rifle.
Cornelia exposes his rigged scale and draws a weapon, demanding the strongbox.
She names the hidden four thousand under the false bottom; he surrenders it.
They echo 'We never met'; she smiles and leaves him shaken.

pd_dollhouse_0.summary: Humming Nora enters in the winter parlor with parcels and a Christmas tree.
Nora tips the porter, sneaks macaroons, and listens at Helmer's door.
Helmer calls out pet names; Nora answers and hides the macaroons.
Nora coaxes Torvald to let them spend more this Christmas.
Helmer lectures against debt; Nora submits, then he teases her with his purse.

s01052.summary: Sleepless Tamara floats in the cramped capsule, eyes open, stars motionless.
She replays identical recorded logs and handles a creased photograph.
She presses her palm to the cold porthole, wiping the fog away.
Recording a new log, Tamara cannot say the lie and stops.

s01068.summary: Evelyn sways alone in the empty marathon hall at hour 487, asking for a cigarette.
Jack shuffles out with a cigarette; they trade jokes about pacing.
Evelyn asks him to dance; they talk of hats and promises.
They speak the same line, laugh, and hold each other as the record skips.

s01044.summary: Orrin and Sable creep into the moth library; Tamsin startles them.
The moths lift, swords ring, and the three tumble into a tangle.
Masked Vesper stills the moths and orders Sable to put down the lantern.

s01091.summary: The Courier holds Hayes at gunpoint and demands the agents drop weapons.
Irina's coin distracts him; Kofi fires and they brawl, freeing Hayes.
Kofi seizes the gun and Irina cuffs the stilled Courier.
Hayes says the Courier was warning him about the Directorate; arrival is imminent.
They rush the Courier and Hayes to the stairwell as headlights sweep in.

pd_dollhouse_2.summary: Nora makes the children swear secrecy about the stranger and sends them off.
Alone, Nora frets and dresses the tree, forcing cheer.
Helmer deduces Krogstad visited and chides Nora for lying.
He pardons her, settles by the stove, and she hesitantly calls him.

s01064.summary: Queen Idrissa and Balthazar challenge trespassing minstrel Finnegan, denying his brother exists.
Morgana emerges, vouches for him, and claims to be the brother; the bridge hums.

s01053.summary: Wardens wait in the shelter as the drone of bombers grows.
Control warns of incendiaries; Edmund orders helmets on and buckets ready.
A strike lands on Albert Road; Edmund learns it is his shop.
Ignoring orders, Edmund leaves Vera in charge and heads out into the fire.

s01103.summary: Cordelia and Artemus wade through the flooded cellar, trading uneasy remarks.
A camera flash reveals a figure against the wall, then nothing.
Artemus begs to leave; Cordelia explains patient forty-one, locked away for hearing things.
A lullaby draws a drowned woman's hand around Cordelia's ankle in darkness.

s01055.summary: Philomena jabs at Artur for missing Sundays and senses he has news.
Artur tells her the doctor wants her in care; she already knows.
Philomena feeds Soledad and shares the secret of the sauce: showing up.
Artur takes his mother's hand while the sauce simmers.

pd_sisters_5.summary: Charlotta performs a shawl trick, producing Anya and Varya to applause.
Lubov frets over Leonid and the estate sale; Varya hopes uncle bought it.
Trofimov teases Varya about Lopakhin; she snaps and admits she wants to marry him.
Yasha announces a broken billiard cue, and Varya storms out.
Lubov chides Trofimov; he complains Varya meddles and insists they are above love.

s01027.summary: Heartbroken Dezi in the empty rink trades wry lines with a boy in a letterman jacket.
He mentions the borrowed car and introduces himself as Junior.
Dezi falls, screams and laughs; Junior joins and they vent about their parents.
Ms. Fairweather finds them and kindly sends Dezi to call her mother.

s01063.summary: Four thieves crouch among the clocks five minutes before midnight, a guard approaching.
They open the panel, clip a wire, and Despina listens to the dome's lock.
Despina matches the lock's rhythm and lifts the dome; Kenji frees the golden sun.
Midnight chimes mask the guard; the crew laughs, relieved, and prepares to leave.

s01089.summary: In the church hospital, Siobhan asks Teddy to search for a signal.
The radio reports the enemy withdrawing; Siobhan tempers hope and checks Oswin.
Rosalind checks Mikhail's wound and they joke quietly about his arm.
A ceasefire at six is announced and exhaustion washes over the room.
Siobhan folds the bloody altar sheet and takes first watch as others sleep.

s00004.summary: On a riverboat, Horace begins a deposition of genial Neely, Miles objecting.
Horace casually asks about guests and sprinklers while Miles warns Neely.
Horace turns to the engine room fire and the door locked from outside.
He produces the signed work order for an exterior bolt from the dead contractor's file.
Neely admits the room was supposed to be empty; Horace writes one line.

s00012.summary: Birgitta dries laundry with her son Tobias in a rainy night laundromat.
Tobias offers his dinosaur to a lone girl, who critiques its brain size.
Birgitta learns Noor's father has been parking for an hour; Noor panics at calling someone.
Noor's father bursts in, relieved, embraces her, and thanks Birgitta; Noor waves goodbye.

s01046.summary: Prudence lingers by the pods; Malcolm emerges, unsurprised, and offers her coat.
She doubts the spreadsheet he rewrote; he calls it streamlining.
Prudence smooths her coat, refuses to leave, asks if he dreams, and exits.
